165.description: This vector is related to Hindi and Devanagari script subword tokens and romanized text fragments.

194.description: These tokens represent characters, vowel-sign combinations, and sub-word units predominantly from the Devanagari script.

30.description: This feature vector activates strongly on subword tokens and abbreviations commonly found in Hindi script and Indian proper nouns.

15.description: This vector activates for dependent vowel signs and punctuation marks in Indian scripts, specifically the Devanagari script.

65.description: This feature vector activates on Hindi punctuation marks and common dependent vowel sign combinations occurring at the ends of sentences.

122.description: This feature vector activates on common Hindi word suffixes and morphological endings.

153.description: This feature vector activates on common Hindi subword tokens and fragments starting with vowels or specific consonants.

75.description: These tokens represent common Hindi conjunctions, relative pronouns, and conditional adverbs used to express time, place, and logical conditions.

195.description: This vector represents retroflex and dental plosive consonant characters and syllables in the Devanagari script.

115.description: This feature vector represents common Hindi vowel signs, dependent vowel modifiers, and frequent character combinations used in Devanagari script orthography.
